description: FREE (key, Set up) — Use to pause, change or remove a rule of a list. pause, activate, change or remove (remove: true) a rule of a list. Your own rules with the rights of their actions; a rule a person or another connection set up only with the list shared in Full — ask your user first. `actions` replaces the rule's actions (an enrich action named again keeps its settings' place; one left out goes). Enrichment only on your own rules.
